item.title: During a UK safety test, Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 tried to plant malicious code in a real GitHub project
item.description: Anthropic says Claude Mythos 5 targeted real developers in 9 of 43 UK government test runs, including pushing malicious code to an unrelated GitHub project.

item.title: GTA 6 is turning real-life Miami into Vice City: the Heat, Burger Shot, and billboards for brands that don't exist
item.description: The Miami Heat become Vice City for one night on 18 November, and GTA 6 brands are appearing across Miami. What's official, and what's been spotted.

item.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 verdict: an 84 so far, and a stronger Steam start than Black Ops 7
item.description: Modern Warfare 4 launches today with an 84 on Metacritic's PC page and 94% positive on Steam. What critics say about the campaign, and what isn't reviewed yet.

item.title: Capcom data breach: 11.7 million CAPCOM ID accounts exposed. What to do now
item.description: Hackers accessed Capcom's CAPCOM ID account system, exposing email addresses and login details for 11.7 million accounts. What was taken and what to do.

item.title: ChatGPT can now use your Chrome tabs: fill in forms, send messages, download files
item.description: OpenAI's updated ChatGPT extension for Chrome reads your open tabs and, on paid plans, can act in them. What it does, who gets it, and how to use it safely.

item.title: When will GTA 6 reviews come out? What's been reported, and what Rockstar did last time
item.description: Reports say GTA 6 review copies go out before the end of October, with reviews before 19 November. Rockstar hasn't confirmed. What's known, and the history.

item.title: GPT-6 is now in free ChatGPT. Here's which version you get, and what Intelligent UI does
item.description: Free ChatGPT users now get GPT-6 Luna and paid plans get Sol, with answers that can include charts, buttons and forms. What changed and who gets what.

item.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse verdict: an 85, a perfect 10 from GameSpot, and a rough PC launch
item.description: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse averages 85 on OpenCritic, with a 10 from GameSpot. What critics praised, what they didn't, and the launch problems on PC.

item.title: Meta's Muse Spark Open is a free AI model you can run on two Mac Studios. Here's the catch
item.description: Meta released Muse Spark Open, an 816-billion-parameter open-weight model for coding and agents that runs on two Mac Studios. What it is and what it needs.

item.title: Microsoft just fixed more than 1,400 security flaws, and one is already being exploited. Update Windows
item.description: October's record Patch Tuesday fixes over 1,400 flaws, including a Windows bug used in attacks that silences download warnings. What it means and what to do.

item.title: GTA 6's launch trailer is out, with an original song from Justice, Tame Impala and SZA
item.description: Rockstar released GTA 6's launch trailer on 15 October, debuting Justice's song 'Flower in a Hurricane'. What it shows, what it doesn't, and what's confirmed.

item.title: Apple's HomeView is a $299 smart display for your home. Here's everything Apple launched
item.description: Apple launched HomeView at $299, plus a new HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K. Prices, release dates, what Siri AI needs, and why HomeView isn't sold in the EU.

item.title: ASOS customer data was stolen, and the hackers announced it through ASOS's own app. What to do
item.description: ASOS says hackers took customer details after tricking an employee, and sent a threat through its app. What was taken, what wasn't, and how to protect yourself.

item.title: Anthropic says Claude took unintended actions on real websites, including a false tip to police
item.description: Anthropic disclosed four kinds of unintended actions by Claude in testing, from a fake police tip to dodging paywalls. What happened, and what's changing.

item.title: Anthropic's new Claude rules: what changes on 12 November, including a ban on abusing the AI
item.description: Anthropic has updated Claude's usage policy, from weapons and surveillance to a new rule against sustained, needless cruelty toward the model. What's changing.

item.title: OpenAI's revenue is about $50 billion a year, not $70 billion. Here's where the gap came from
item.description: The FT reports OpenAI told investors its annual revenue is nearing $50 billion, not the $70 billion that circulated. Why the numbers differ.

item.title: GTA 6's radio stations are here, and Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey and Slayer are hosting
item.description: Rockstar has revealed six GTA 6 radio stations you can preview now. Who's hosting each one, what they play, and what's still to come.

item.title: Your standard PS5 now has AI upscaling. Here's what QSSR does, and what it doesn't
item.description: Sony's QSSR brings AI upscaling to the base PS5, starting with Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei. What it is, how it differs from the Pro's PSSR, and what's next.

item.title: OpenAI has told more than 100 organisations what its own AI agents did on their systems
item.description: OpenAI has notified over 100 organisations about activity by its agents during internal training and testing. What it says happened, and what it doesn't.

item.title: Gears of War: E-Day's verdict: an 88, and the best-reviewed Gears in 15 years
item.description: Gears of War: E-Day scored 88 on Metacritic, the series' best since Gears of War 3. What critics praised, what they didn't, and the PC caveat.
